title: festuca picturata
intro: Festuca picturata, commonly known as Alpine Fescue, is a type of grass native to mountainous regions in Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The health benefits of Festuca picturata include its ability to ease symptoms of bronchitis, coughs, and colds due to its expectorant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
